evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We also introduce ImageReq-Bench, a benchmark of 961 requests built around hard cases in real-world image-generation requests, each paired with an evaluation checklist.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We present ImageRSI, a framework that keeps the image generator frozen and combines three components: five-dimensional verification and repair within each task, an experience library shared across tasks, and offline updating of the judge.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: ImageRSI achieves a Checklist Strict Accuracy (CSA) of 52.6% on MindBench (with Nano Banana Pro as the generator) and 65.66% on ImageReq-Bench, and we compare system outcomes across judge-training configurations.
